_comment: Copy to characters.json and fill in. slug -> canvas location. This is the ONLY pointer to real data in the repo, and it holds pointers only — no character values. The values live in the canvas sheet. characters.json is gitignored.

workspace._comment: Brand-level pointers. Research is workspace-scoped, not character-scoped.

example._comment: Rename this key to your character's slug. 'tab' is the canvas tab in the spreadsheet — create it before running character_assets.py.
example._comment_assets: Written by execution/character_assets.py — it uploads the file to Drive, makes it link-readable, and drops an =IMAGE() into the cell. You do not hand-write these; the script fills them in.
example._comment_strips: Wardrobe and environment strips. Same story: the script writes these.
example._comment_products: Product shots, if this is a product account. Empty is fine for a growth account.
